facts.value: An organization dedicated to promoting our culture amongst the community of Eritrean and Ethiopian Harvard undergraduate and graduate students, the general Harvard community, and all those living in the Greater Boston/Cambridge area.

facts.value: Advocating for Uyghur issues and celebrating Uyghur culture.

facts.value: A new space for Bengali students to connect with their cultural roots.
facts.quote: Students from Bangladesh and West Bengal joined together during the Covid-19 pandemic and founded the Bengali Association of Students at Harvard — a new space for Bengali students to connect with their cultural roots.

facts.value: The program sends Harvard women and other female scientists into schools each week to mentor young girls and foster enthusiasm about science.
